programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Escape to Yibin
programme.desc: Yibin is hailed as "The First City along the Yangtze River", home to renowned Yibin Ranmian noodles and Wuliangye liquor. We explored plenty of lesser-known scenic spots: Lizhuang, the cultural hub during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression; vast bamboo groves that embody the hermit culture of China; and the mysterious cliff-hanging coffins. It is precisely these secluded and strategically advantageous lands that enabled local cultures to be well preserved amid turbulent times.

programme.title: A Touch of Speed: The Art of Wing Chun
programme.desc: Uncover the principles of Wing Chun, a unique Chinese martial art renowned for its efficiency and directness. This program explores its legendary origins, core concepts like the center line theory, and its practical application in close-quarters combat. Witness the subtle power and intellectual depth of this sophisticated fighting system.

programme.title: A Canopy of Umbrellas, a Sichuan Serenade
programme.desc: The documentary "A Canopy of Umbrellas, a Sichuan Serenade" follows a father and son as they carry forward the centuries-old craft of making Luzhou oil-paper umbrellas. Each umbrella tells a story—not only of skill, but of family and cultural resilience. As part of CGTN’s original series "Next Stop: China," this episode journeys into the lush bamboo forests of Sichuan, where traditional craftsmanship finds new life in the modern world.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: The Great Wall Homestay
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, Tianran He's heading to the mountains on Beijing’s northern outskirts, to meet some people his age who have swapped city life for the chance to run guesthouses beside the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-6 Shandong Mantis Style
programme.desc: The final episode traces the cross-ocean transmission of Shandong Mantis Style. In the mountains of northern Italy, host Kleber visits Dante Basili, a veteran Italian practitioner in his sixties, who recounts travelling to China 36 years ago to learn Mantis Style and returning home to teach Chinese martial arts ever since. Kleber then heads to Shandong to meet Yu Bo and Yu Tao, sons of Mantis Style grandmaster Yu Hai. He witnesses a traditional apprenticeship ceremony and explores the style’s fighting essence: adopting its spirit rather than merely copying its form. The episode shows how Mantis Style has taken root and flourished in different cultural settings. Ultimately, this journey across Europe and Asia suggests that transmission is not only about techniques, but also about dialogue across time and distance, and a shared resonance of spirit between cultures.

programme.desc: Meet Sun Chenxi, a 12-year-old soccer "star" from Ningbo who first picked up the game at the age of four and is already playing with the confidence of a veteran. Sun says he dreams of turning pro one day and leading China's men's team to the World Cup. Dribbling and passing with skills far more advanced than his age, he has won over audiences far and wide after his father posted clips of Sun flashing his fancy footwork on social media. The soon-to-be-teenager now has millions of followers online. Already recognized as a rising young talent, high hopes are pinned on Sun as he is cheered on by his parents, friends, and throngs of fans online.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise Quanzhou

So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Escape to Yibin
programme.desc: Yibin is hailed as "The First City along the Yangtze River", home to renowned Yibin Ranmian noodles and Wuliangye liquor. We explored plenty of lesser-known scenic spots: Lizhuang, the cultural hub during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression; vast bamboo groves that embody the hermit culture of China; and the mysterious cliff-hanging coffins. It is precisely these secluded and strategically advantageous lands that enabled local cultures to be well preserved amid turbulent times.

programme.title: A Touch of Speed: The Art of Wing Chun
programme.desc: Uncover the principles of Wing Chun, a unique Chinese martial art renowned for its efficiency and directness. This program explores its legendary origins, core concepts like the center line theory, and its practical application in close-quarters combat. Witness the subtle power and intellectual depth of this sophisticated fighting system.

programme.title: A Canopy of Umbrellas, a Sichuan Serenade
programme.desc: The documentary "A Canopy of Umbrellas, a Sichuan Serenade" follows a father and son as they carry forward the centuries-old craft of making Luzhou oil-paper umbrellas. Each umbrella tells a story—not only of skill, but of family and cultural resilience. As part of CGTN’s original series "Next Stop: China," this episode journeys into the lush bamboo forests of Sichuan, where traditional craftsmanship finds new life in the modern world.

programme.title: Young star on green field
programme.desc: Meet Sun Chenxi, a 12-year-old soccer "star" from Ningbo who first picked up the game at the age of four and is already playing with the confidence of a veteran. Sun says he dreams of turning pro one day and leading China's men's team to the World Cup. Already recognized as a rising young talent, high hopes are pinned on Sun as he is cheered on by his parents, friends, and throngs of fans online.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: The Great Wall Homestay
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, Tianran He's heading to the mountains on Beijing’s northern outskirts, to meet some people his age who have swapped city life for the chance to run guesthouses beside the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: World Heritages in China: A Journey on Water from Wuxi to Yixing
programme.desc: Water has always been the heartbeat of human civilization, nurturing the cities it weaves through. From the first drops that carved out its waterways to the thriving metropolis we see today, Wuxi’s story is inseparable from the grand canal. This is the story of a city born of water. In this episode, we uncover how the waters have shaped Wuxi’s identity.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 2
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the grand old mansions of Nanjing’s merchant families and take a stroll through their exquisite gardens, where Nature is incorporated into the architecture. From centuries-old Qing Dynasty residences to traditional folk handicrafts, join us on a deep dive into Nanjing’s rich cultural heritage.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: Basketball dreams soar in Liangshan
programme.desc: Meet basketball girl Aguolieha, who comes from a rural village in the mountainous Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in southwest China. Playing for a local team called the Blackhawks, the 13-year-old has a big dream: to become a professional player one day and join Team China. At first, her father was not supportive as he feared that sports training would make her grades fall. Proving to be excellent both academically and on the court, she often looks up to her idol Stephen Curry, and trains hard with her peers. She believes that the sky's the limit and that basketball games will help her dreams soar.

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chaozhou
programme.desc: In this episode, hosts Tianran He and Angela Fu are in Chaozhou, South China. They're on a quest to discover the secrets of its success, for Chaozhou is famed for its wealthy merchant guilds and its homegrown Teochew cuisine, which enjoys global recognition. From working as part-timers in a beef hotpot restaurant, to learning about tea ceremony and shadowing a master of Teochew cuisine, our hosts discover the best way to learn about Chaozhou, is through its food.

programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation
programme.desc: Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. It is a site of an ancient city, ancient kingdom and ancient Shu culture in southwest of China, which is the largest in area, longest in time span and richest in cultural connotation. The total area covers 12 square kilometers, which was built over 3000 years ago. The cultural relics at Sanxingdui are precious cultural heritage of mankind, which contain rich historical, cultural and scientific value, and bespeak themselves as the most attractive ones amongst the multitude of the spectacular relics in China. In this episode, under the guide of the presenter, we visit the Sanxingdui Site Garden, archaeological Site and Sanxingdui Museum, show the amazing giant bronze mask, exquisite gold stuff, marvelous bronze divine tree etc., re-explore this mysterious and great civilization 3000 years ago.

programme.title: Wudang Martial Arts and Taichi
programme.desc: Join host Yegor on a journey into the heart of China’s Wudang Mountains—the spiritual cradle of Taoism and the birthplace of Wudang martial arts. Through in-depth conversations with renowned masters such as Zhong Xueyong, Cai Chongguang, Jake Pinnick, and Liu Xiang, this episode explores the philosophy, techniques, and living spirit of Wudang Quan and Taichi. From the internal cultivation of qi to the harmony between body and mind, Wudang martial arts are more than just physical training—they are a way of life rooted in the Tao. Alongside martial techniques, the program also delves into traditional Chinese music, calligraphy, and medicine, revealing how these disciplines come together in the pursuit of balance, self-awareness, and longevity. This is not just a story of punches and postures, but of tradition, transformation, and the timeless search for harmony between humans and the universe.

programme.title: Shared Roots in Wrestling
programme.desc: The documentary “Shared Roots in Wrestling” follows a young wrestler from Tianjin as he journeys to Inner Mongolia to explore the shared heritage of Chinese-style wrestling and Bökh, the region’s national wrestling tradition. Part of CGTN’s original series “Next Stop: China,” this episode uncovers how strength, skill, and resilience connect athletes across city streets and endless grasslands, carrying forward a legacy that transcends geography and generations.

programme.title: Basketball dreams soar in Liangshan
programme.desc: Meet basketball girl Aguolieha, who comes from a rural village in the mountainous Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in southwest China. Playing for a local team called the Blackhawks, the 13-year-old has a big dream: to become a professional player one day and join Team China. At first, her father was not supportive as he feared that sports training would make her grades fall. Proving to be excellent both academically and on the court, she often looks up to her idol Stephen Curry, and trains hard with her peers. She believes that the sky's the limit and that basketball games will help her dreams soar.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

programme.desc: En un bosque, junto a una aldea lejana, los habitantes están siendo brutalmente asesinados y la Bestia es perseguido como el responsable. Sin embargo, un grupo de aldeanos, junto con Bella, descubrirán que hay algo más tras la aparente culpabilidad de la Bestia.

programme.title: Robot Apocalypse
programme.desc: Cuando la experta hacker Tara intenta detener a una poderosa inteligencia artificial que se apodera del ejército mundial, la inteligencia artificial la considera una terrorista que debe ser exterminada.

programme.title: American Yakuza
programme.desc: Un agente americano del FBI es atraído por la mafia japonesa -la Yakuza- en esta película de acción.

programme.title: USS Seaviper
programme.desc: El submarino alemán, U-234, del puerto de Kiel está intercambiando carga con los japoneses. USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio.

programme.title: El Cobrador 2
programme.desc: Two debt collectors are plunged into an extremely dangerous situation, pursuing various criminals while evading a vengeful enemy.

programme.title: Bermuda Tentacles
programme.desc: Cuando el Air Force One se hunde en el Triángulo de las Bermudas, la Marina envía a su mejor equipo de rescate. Pero al rescatar al presidente, el equipo despierta a una criatura que amenaza a toda la costa este.

programme.title: El asesino de al lado
programme.desc: El arquitecto Jonathan se muda a un complejo de apartamentos con patio de Los Ángeles, entonces uno de sus vecinos es asesinado por error.. Jonathan era la víctima prevista.

programme.title: Collider
programme.desc: En el año 2033, una joven atrapada en un misterioso orfanato viaja imprudentemente al pasado para encontrar a sus padres y enmendar su pasado.

programme.title: El tren de la muerte
programme.desc: Un tren con rehenes es robado en Bremen, Alemania. Se dirige al sur de Europa con una bomba nuclear. Un grupo especial de lucha contra el crimen de la ONU se encarga de detenerlo en cooperación con militares y policías locales.

programme.title: Scarecrow
programme.desc: Seis estudiantes de secundaria se enfrentan a una entidad maligna mientras cumplen su castigo antes del festival del espantapájaros del pueblo.

programme.title: Gagarin, Pionero del Espacio
programme.desc: El 12 de abril de 1961, el cosmonauta soviético Yuri Gagarin despegó en un cohete Vostok y orbitó alrededor de la Tierra durante 108 minutos. Seleccionado entre más de tres mil pilotos de combate de toda la Unión Soviética, Gagarin tuvo que entrenarse rápidamente para realizar el viaje de su vida.

programme.title: War of the world annihilation
programme.desc: Tras una dura invasión alienígena, la única esperanza de supervivencia de una madre y su hijo reside en descubrir una verdad impensable.

programme.title: Catástrofe Inminente
programme.desc: Una gran oleada de asteroides atraviesa el Sistema Solar provocando que la Tierra salga de su órbita y sufriendo una gran devastación. La única oportunidad para los supervivientes es que la fuerza del Sol recupere el control sobre la Tierra pero, aunque lo haga, la vida en el planeta habrá cambiado para siempre. Si alguien te dijera que el mundo se acabará mañana, ¿le creerías?

programme.title: Speed Asesino
programme.desc: Dos mejores amigos utilizan aviones de alta tecnología construidos por ellos mismos para llevar droga de México a California y financiar así su estilo de vida en Hollywood.

programme.title: La saison des Requins
programme.desc: Trois kayakistes luttent pour leur vie lorsqu'un grand requin blanc les piège sur une petite île en train de sombrer.

programme.title: Fatal Instinct
programme.desc: Un détective de police suit une piste d'indices qui semble finalement mener au frère ex-détenu de son partenaire de confiance, qu'il a aidé à mettre en prison il y a des années.

programme.title: Le Meurtrier
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller d'action haletant, un chauffeur de taxi de Yanji, dans la préfecture autonome coréenne de Yanbian, au nord-est de la Chine, se rend en Corée du Sud à la demande d'un gangster local qui lui propose d'éliminer un professeur en échange du remboursement de sa dette. Parallèlement, il recherche sa femme, venue le rejoindre mais sans nouvelles depuis six mois. Ses soupçons d'infidélité le rongent, jusqu'à ce qu'un événement inattendu survienne cette nuit-là. Alors qu'il s'apprête à tuer le professeur, il se retrouve bientôt en fuite, traqué par la police et la mafia, donnant lieu à de violents combats et à d'intenses courses-poursuites.

programme.title: Crash lunaire
programme.desc: Deux entreprises, l'une sidérurgique et l'autre aérospatiale, décident de s'associer afin d'exploiter les ressources de la Lune. Mais, un accident de forage provoque une fissure et précipite un morceau de l'astre sélène vers la Terre.

programme.title: Assaut sur Wall Street
programme.desc: Jim est un New-Yorkais ordinaire menant une vie paisible avec un emploi bien rémunéré et une famille aimante. Soudain, tout bascule lorsque l’économie s’effondre, faisant perdre à Jim tout ce qu’il avait. Rempli de colère et de rage, Jim craque et va jusqu’à l’extrême pour se venger de la vie qu’on lui a arrachée.

programme.title: King Rising 3
programme.desc: Dominic Purcell se transforme d’un tueur à gages moderne en guerrier médiéval dans cette aventure pleine d’action inspirée de la série de jeux vidéo Dungeon Siege. Découvrez des effets spéciaux époustouflants qui donnent vie à une action ininterrompue. Un tueur à gages est transporté au Moyen Âge, où il doit affronter une armée gigantesque – et un dragon cracheur de feu – dans une bataille acharnée pour survivre !

programme.title: The Tower
programme.desc: Au cour de la « White Christmas » parti du complexe ultra-luxueux « Sky Tower », un feu se déclare. Le feu a commencé lorsque les hélicoptères supposés saupoudrer de la neige au-dessus du bâtiment sont entrés en contact avec le bâtiment. Les pompiers sont rapidement envoyés afin de sauver l’ensemble des locataires et les invités VIP du building.

programme.title: La Colonie
programme.desc: Des groupes de personnes – des colonies – sont forcés de vivre sous terre à cause d'une nouvelle ère glaciaire. La Colonie 7 part vérifier la situation de la Colonie 5, avec laquelle ils ont perdu le contact. Sur place, ils découvrent que la colonie est tombée et qu’un tout nouvel ennemi les attend sur le chemin du retour.

programme.title: L'enfant d'Osiris
programme.desc: Dans une époque de colonisation interplanétaire, Sy Lombrok (Kellan Lutz), un ancien infirmier devenu vagabond au passé tourmenté, forme une alliance improbable avec Kane Sommerville (Daniel MacPherson), un lieutenant travaillant pour le sous-traitant militaire Exor. Dans une course contre la montre, ils tentent de sauver Indi (Teagan Croft), la jeune fille de Kane, alors qu’une crise mondiale imminente provoquée par Exor menace la planète.

programme.title: Dystopia
programme.desc: Nous sommes en 2037. Notre monde se meurt lentement d'un virus qui a rendu l'humanité stérile. Aucun enfant n'est né depuis 25 ans. Les gouvernements sont devenus les marionnettes impuissantes des plus grandes entreprises et Biocorp, la plus grande du monde, ne cesse de promettre un remède qui ne viendra jamais

programme.title: La Division
programme.desc: Dans les années 90, Rio de Janeiro a été secouée par une vague d’enlèvements. Les forces de sécurité font appel à des agents controversés pour aider à sauver la ville des criminels, mais aussi de la police elle-même.

programme.title: Piégés
programme.desc: Dans un flash-back, Ernesto, un jeune escroc, nous raconte comment il est arrivé au bord d'un gros coup : enfance dans un orphelinat, jeunes cambriolages à l'arraché jusqu'à ce que son partenaire se fasse prendre, puis encadrement par Lefty, un escroc vieillissant.

programme.title: T-34 Machine de Guerre
programme.desc: À l’époque des plus grandes épreuves de l’histoire de l’humanité, lorsque la vie des êtres chers dépend de chaque action, deux ennemis jurés vont s’effondrer. Retenu captif, le jeune lieutenant Ivushkin prépare une évasion audacieuse. Il rassemble un équipage et défie les as des chars allemands menés par Jager. Pour ses proches et son pays, Ivushkin est prêt à aller jusqu’au bout.

programme.title: Entre Dios y el Diablo
programme.desc: Un hombre accede al mapa de un tesoro y convence a un guía (Juan Chasquisdo) para que le acompañe en su búsqueda para recuperarlo. Ambos son perseguidos por bandidos.

programme.title: Golia E Il Cavaliere Mascherato
programme.desc: Tra castelli, duelli e congiure, Golia affronta nemici mascherati per difendere il regno e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: El Hombre el orgullo y la venganza
programme.desc: Un incondicional soldado español recurre a la delincuencia para demostrar su amor por una misteriosa y promiscua gitana.

programme.title: Golia Alla Conquista Di Bagdad
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte, battaglie e colpi di scena, Golia affronta nemici e tradimenti per salvare Baghdad e difendere il regno. Diretto da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: Erode Il Grande
programme.desc: Tra potere, intrighi e tensioni di corte, Erode difende il trono affrontando tradimenti e scelte che segnano il destino del regno

programme.title: El calle de los conflictos
programme.desc: Un sheriff intenta detener los conflictos entre colonos en el Oeste tras la Guerra de Secesión.

programme.title: Il Vecchio Testamento
programme.desc: Dalla creazione ai grandi profeti, episodi biblici prendono vita tra miracoli, prove e destini che segnano la storia dell’umanità.

programme.title: 7 Winchester per un Massacro
programme.desc: Un pistolero se une a una banda de guerrilleros confederados para encontrar un alijo de oro confederado desaparecido.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP19 - Los asesinos a sueldo
programme.desc: Hoss y Little Joe son confundidos con sanguinarios asesinos a sueldo en un pequeño pueblo de Texas dominado por dos familias enemistadas.

programme.title: Sandokan Alla Riscossa
programme.desc: Tra mari esotici e scontri contro il potere coloniale, Sandokan torna a combattere per la libertà del suo popolo, tra arrembaggi e duelli.

programme.title: Sonora
programme.desc: En 1931 en México, bajo la presión del gobierno de Sonora, un grupo de personas se ven obligadas a viajar a Mexicalli, donde se enfrentan al racismo y a otros peligros en el desierto

programme.title: Sandokan Contro Il Leopardo Di Sarawak
programme.desc: Tra giungle e mari esotici, Sandokan sfida il temibile Leopardo di Sarawak in una lotta tra vendetta e libertà, tra duelli e battaglie spettacolari.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: Durante el fragor de la batalla en plena Guerra Civil, nace un potro seductoramente inocente de la querida yegua del soldado Jim Rabb. Rechazando la orden de matarlo para que no se convierta en un estorbo, Rabb se queda con el potro como consuelo en estos tiempos desesperados, un símbolo de esperanza que lleva a los hombres del Primer Arma de Caballería a un viaje de autodescubrimiento y nueva hermandad.

programme.title: Erik Il Vichingo
programme.desc: Tra terre nordiche e battaglie epiche, il guerriero Erik affronta nemici e tradimenti in una lotta per onore e potere, tra duelli e conquiste. Diretto da Mario Caiano con Giuliano Gemma.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Un hombre inculpado de asesinato escapa de la cárcel y se dirige al Oeste, donde se une a una banda en la que está implicado el verdadero asesino.

programme.title: Zorro Contro Maciste
programme.desc: Tra duelli e imprese eroiche, Zorro e Maciste uniscono le forze contro un potere tirannico, tra azione e colpi di scena. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi

programme.title: Cruce de Bastardos
programme.desc: Sigue la historia de Cam Talcutt, un hombre que ganó un puesto comercial en un juego de cartas.

programme.title: Giuseppe Venduto Dai Fratelli
programme.desc: Tradito dai fratelli e venduto come schiavo, Giuseppe affronta prove durissime in Egitto fino a diventare uomo di fiducia del faraone.

programme.title: El angel vengador
programme.desc: Miles Utley es un comando/guardaespaldas mormón profesional que se ve obligado a convertirse en renegado y a cuestionar su fe cuando investiga un escándalo de asesinato y especulación de tierras.

programme.title: I Sette Gladiatori
programme.desc: Un grande film d'avventura con scontri fino all'ultimo sangue. Il gladiatore Dario, libero grazie alle sue vittorie, torna in patria. Qui, al posto del padre che vi governava, trova un tiranno usurpatore che l'ha ucciso. Con l'aiuto di sei validi combattenti, cercherà di rimettere tutto al proprio posto.

programme.title: El último hijo
programme.desc: Un forajido intenta acabar con su descendencia eliminando a su malvada línea consanguínea.

programme.title: Maciste All'inferno
programme.desc: Tra inferi, magie oscure e creature demoniache, Maciste affronta una sfida estrema per salvare innocenti dal male.

programme.title: Eminence Hills
programme.desc: Un rastro de venganza conduce a un notorio asesino y a un agente de la ley a un pueblo de fanáticos. Correrá la sangre.

programme.title: La Vendetta Dei Gladiatori
programme.desc: Nell’antica Roma, un eroe affronta tradimenti e duelli mortali per vendicare il proprio popolo e sfidare il potere

programme.title: Lone Rider
programme.desc: Con un alentador drama familiar y una acción que sube la adrenalina, Lone Rider es un western con agallas, gloria y un poderoso mensaje. Bob Hattaway, un soldado honrado, regresa a su pueblo natal del Oeste para descubrir que el terrateniente corrupto Stu Croaker se ha convertido en el hombre más poderoso del condado.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Gladiatore
programme.desc: Diretto da Alfonso Brescia con Mark Forest, un gladiatore affronta tiranni e tradimenti in una Roma dominata dal potere.

programme.title: La Fiebre de la Pradera
programme.desc: El ex sheriff borracho Preston Biggs consigue un billete de salida de la cárcel y un puñado de dinero para escoltar a tres novias por correo rechazadas medio locas hasta el tren más cercano de vuelta al Este.

programme.title: Samoa, Regina Della Giungla
programme.desc: Diretto da Guido Malatesta, con Edwige Fenech.Tra giungle inesplorate e pericoli nascosti, una coraggiosa regina guida il suo popolo contro invasori e tradimenti, tra azione e avventura.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Jeb Drummond es un pastor de ovejas asesino que ha tomado a Adam como rehén para intentar obligar a Ben a cederle una gran parte de las tierras de Ponderosa.

programme.title: West of the divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden se hace pasar por un hombre buscado y se une a la banda de Gentry sólo para enterarse más tarde de que Gentry fue quien mató a su padre. Salva de Gentry el rancho del padre de Virginia Winters y también rescata a su hermano Spud, perdido hace mucho tiempo.

programme.title: La Rivolta Dei Mercenari
programme.desc: In un territorio sconvolto dalla ribellione, un gruppo di spietati mercenari viene ingaggiato per reprimere una rivolta, ma tradimenti e ambizioni personali accendono una lotta feroce per il potere.

programme.title: La Balada de Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Un gángster supuestamente muerto quiere implicar a un hombre completamente inocente para que pague por sus crímenes y así poder dar esquinazo a sus vengadores y perseguidores.

programme.title: Afrodite, Dea Dell'amore
programme.desc: Tra passioni proibite, intrighi di corte e sfide al potere, Afrodite intreccia destino e seduzione nel cuore del mito. Con Anthony Steffen e Isabelle Corey.

programme.title: Fuera de la Ley
programme.desc: Tom Carter envía a su hijo Billy a buscar la ayuda del sheriff cuando la granja está siendo atacada por los secuaces del vecino Jon Pryce. Billy regresa, encuentra a su padre asesinado y se dispone a encontrar a los asesinos que contrató Pryce, Black Jack y su banda.

programme.title: On m'appelle King
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes traque une bande de trafiquants d'armes à travers la frontière mexicaine.

programme.title: Amigo!... Mon colt a deux mots à te dire
programme.desc: Un vagabond aux poings rapides et un proxénète armé de pistolets rapides aident un enfant à réclamer son héritage.

programme.title: No Name & Dynamite
programme.desc: No Name and Dynamite commence lorsque nous rencontrons le partenariat de chasse aux primes entre No Name (Northup) et Dynamite Davenport (Ting), qui font leur propre chemin pour collecter les primes, mais s'entraident lorsqu'il s'agit des primes les plus difficiles.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Jacob Darien conduit sa famille de quakers à travers Virginia City. Lorsqu'il est accosté par des brutes de la ville, Adam Cartwright intervient avec l'aide de son nouveau compagnon de route, Sam Bord. Adam propose d'escorter le train de chariots à travers le Ponderosa, sans savoir que Sam prépare un vol.

programme.title: Ta tombe est prête Sartana !
programme.desc: Deux cow-boys se font voler leur or dans les montagnes rocheuses et décident de se défendre en affrontant les bandits.

programme.title: Macho Callaghan se déchaîne
programme.desc: Un tireur solitaire traque les membres d'un gang de hors-la-loi qui a tué ses amis.

programme.title: Billy va te plomber
programme.desc: Quatre hors-la-loi de l'Ouest effectuent un braquage de banque dans la ville de la ruée vers l'or, Bath Water. Alors que le groupe se lance à la poursuite, les choses empirent, car les bandits se rendent compte qu'ils ont été doublés.

programme.title: Killer Kid
programme.desc: L'impitoyable et cruel capitaine Ramirez traque et tue les révolutionnaires dans sa quête du Saint, le chef vertueux de l'insurrection mexicaine contre les Fédéraux.

programme.title: Planques toi minable, Trinita arrive...
programme.desc: Après plusieurs tentatives d'escroquerie infructueuses, l'escroc Jonathan Duke et son partenaire Sebastian Carter font équipe avec Ringo et sa bande pour dévaliser le général mexicain Eldorado.

programme.title: Corsicana
programme.desc: Le shérif adjoint Bass Reeves retrouve son ancien partenaire et fugitif Sam Tanner. Avec un ancien tireur d'élite de l'Union, ils font face à une course contre la montre pour retrouver Jack Donner et sa bande impitoyable de tueurs.

programme.title: Route mystérieuse
programme.desc: Un détective aborigène retourne dans l'Outback australien pour enquêter sur le meurtre d'une jeune fille.

programme.title: On continue à l'appeller Trinita
programme.desc: Bambino essaie d'apprendre à son frère Trinity comment devenir un hors-la-loi, mais ils finissent par sauver une famille de pionniers et à défaire un réseau de contrebande.

programme.title: On l'appelle Trinita
programme.desc: Un tireur paresseux et peu orthodoxe et son frère corpulent et voleur de chevaux défendent une colonie mormone contre un major accapareur de terres, un bandit mexicain et leurs hommes de main.

programme.title: Je vais... je tire... et je reviens
programme.desc: Un gang dérobe une cargaison d'or dans un train. Un soi-disant chasseur de primes est envoyé à la recherche des voleurs et décide de les laisser le conduire jusqu'à l'or.

programme.title: Texas
programme.desc: A Dallas, un ancien soldat de l'Union tente de démasquer une conspiration de Sudistes qui ont assassiné son père, son ami et le Président.

programme.title: Foodwise: Haikou
programme.desc: Haikou, also known as "Coconut City," is famous for its coconut-infused cuisine. In this episode, Foodwise host Tianran heads to this coastal city to sample coconut chicken hotpot, fruity and spicy soups, silky Hainan pickled noodles, and check out Haikou’s famous local teahouses. Here, food and lifestyle go hand in hand—a perfect reflection of the city's slow, easy rhythm.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: Follow Foodwise host Tianran as he tracks down Hainan’s four culinary treasures: Wenchang chicken, Jiaji duck, Dongshan goat, and Hele crab. He soon learns what makes these dishes so famous isn’t just their taste, it’s the animals themselves: chickens raised on coconuts, ducks that brave typhoons, cliff-grazing goats and crabs fattened in brackish waters—proving that in Hainan, the best dishes come with a story.

programme.title: Me and My Corps
programme.desc: This documentary offers an in-depth look into the lives of those living and working in the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps. Divided into four chapters, it tells the stories of ordinary people—capturing their daily lives and the spirit of the era they embody.

programme.title: Yangtze: The River of Life Ep.1
programme.desc: This documentary reveals the current ecological state of the Yangtze River basin—including its fish, wildlife, and plant life—while documenting the efforts behind the Yangtze River protection initiative.

programme.title: General Guan Yu Ep.1
programme.desc: This documentary is a unique exploration of the late Eastern Han dynasty general Guan Yu. Through a gaming team's recreation of the Battle of Xiangfan, overseas collections of his porcelain sculptures, and a coming-of-age ceremony at Guandi temple, this episode recounts his military achievements, while describing a man of loyalty, righteousness, courage, and honor—and an enduring spiritual symbol for the Chinese people.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: The sun heats the Earth, and life begins again. As they prepare to breed, animals wake from hibernation and build nests in treetops and caves. Whether reptiles, birds, or mammals, all the spring babies fight for survival through their first, most challenging days.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: These are the days of thirst: it is hot. Only the mountains are cool; everywhere else suffers in heat between 40 and 50°C. The rain is long forgotten. Each day is a search for shade and water. Amphibians bury themselves in mud to escape dehydration. The rest of the wild must wait for the cool of the night to move.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: As the woods prepare to sleep and mushrooms grow as the first rains fall, flocks of cranes migrate home to Spain from their summer season in the north. The stags clash their antlers in pursuit of the does; there is little time before winter sets in.

programme.title: Africa: The Serengeti
programme.desc: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

programme.title: Giant Sea Serpent: Meet the Myth
programme.desc: Its 10-meter length and silver ribbon shape inspired the myth of the sea serpent. Off the French Riviera, buoys set 2,000 meters deep attract pelagic species, including the Giant Oarfish—“King of Herrings”—drifting vertically, alone or in pairs. With expert guidance and passionate collaborators, a scientific expedition unveils the biology of this mysterious ambassador of the abyss.

programme.title: Swimming with Legends
programme.desc: Shot over 2 years and in 9 different destinations, Swimming with Legends documents the life of a Belgium freediver Fred Buyle and his lasting fascination for the legends of the deep as described in ancient texts and mariner's nightmares.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: In this episode of Aging in the Wild, we explore the physiological secrets and factors that determine life expectancy in various animal species. From the seventy-year-old elephant to the quasi-immortal hydra, and the more than a hundred-year-old tortoise, we explore life expectancy, longevity and senescence. Can we distinguish between the effects of the environment and the internal adaptations that lead to longevity? What are some of the benefits associated with aging in nature?

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Reproduction is not only a concern of the young and restless: this episode of Aging in the Wild brings a light-hearted look at the issue of sexuality and camaraderie in older animals. We illustrate, for example, the link between the age of an elephant and its reproductive success. What are the reproductive benefits of these animals as they grow older? Through hearing their stories, we learn of some of the advantages - and disadvantages - of late-life reproduction.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Observing two massive elk clashing their antlers is to witness a true demonstration of power. For other species, such as the European marmot, remaining in power is a matter of collaborating with family and community. Are these animals forced to give up their hard-won social status as they age? Through this lens, we take a deep and entertaining look at the challenges faced by those in power ... and what it takes to stay there.

programme.title: River Jaws
programme.desc: Wells catfish! Over the last fifty years, it has colonised most of Europe's rivers - even the most polluted. This intruder has become the largest freshwater animal in Europe, and even hunts on shore.

programme.title: Kanga Pan: An African Horror Story
programme.desc: Kanga Pan – An African Horror Story is a spine-chilling, one-off wildlife documentary, the first of its kind. A relatively unknown inland waterhole in Mana Pools National Park, Kanga Pan is a gathering point for a melting pot of wildlife species. On the surface, it looks like a peaceful oasis, offering the cooling refreshment of water and bathing.

programme.title: Expedition Wallacea
programme.desc: In 1850, Alfred Russell Wallace investigates the island world of the malayan archipelagos -- and discovers that the nature there is separated into two parts through a mysterious magical border. A border which still bears his name: The 'Wallace-Line.' 150 years later, a new generation of investigators travel to the mysteries Wallace-Line to investigate under water. They dive down to a mystical world, a world in which Wallace was never able to get into. The investors want to find out if a 'marine' Wallace-Line exists.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau explores the famous waterfalls and geysers of Iceland. Then he travels up a volcanic mountain, which is expected to erupt at any moment. Philippe also discovers how Iceland uses geothermal and hydro power to produce all their electricity. Finally, Philippe hikes on one of the largest glaciers in the country.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau travels to Sedona, Arizona, where we look at the spectacular red rock formations. Then we travel to Hawaii, which has red, black and green beaches.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau visits the Hawaiian Islands and explores their traditional methods of catching fish and collecting sea salt. Philippe also dives off the coast of Maui and discovers sea creatures along the coral reef. We also travel to Kauai and search a limestone cave where ancient artifacts are preserved.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau visits the amazing landscape of Croatia, which has some of the worlds' most amazing waterfalls and caves. At the Plitvice Lakes National Park, Philippe explores the ever changing lakes systems due to naturally forming dams.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: It was the Dark Ages… and from the cold North Sea a pagan maritime civilization exploded… and brutally raided and terrorized Europe… they were the Vikings.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: China is one of the world’s oldest civilizations and has one of the most well-­‐documented historical accounts in existence. Rich with records of early dynasties, warfare, ancient traditions and architecture, China is home to some of the most amazing archaeological sites in the world.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Lost civilizations, shipwrecks, sea creatures and sunken treasure…our oceans cover seventy-one percent of the Earth’s surface and yet, more than ninety-five percent is yet to be explored. This final frontier offers a hidden world of secrets to uncover.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Alexander the Great…Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt…Vlad III Dracul, Prince of Romania…the legacy of these historical icons live on in our modern day culture, but the mysterious circumstances that surround their deaths and conflicting reports of their final resting places have inspired worldwide investigation and unleashed a furious hunt to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Secrets of the Universe
programme.desc: We are at the beginning of a period of unprecedented technological advancement, catalyzing a new age of scientific discovery. Travel with us on this immersive giant screen film, as we explore the most exciting machines ever conceived by man, including the Large Hadron Collider and James Webb Space Telescope. See how these new experiments allow us to look deeper into our origins, and unveil the mysteries of dark energy, dark matter and extra dimensions.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: You don’t have to be a heavyweight in the animal kingdom to possess killer instincts, but it sure does help. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we’ll meet three scale-tipping heavyweights.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Killer instincts plus intelligence ensures survival in the most imaginative ways. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we’ll get to see how the cute dolphin is actually a highly cunning pack hunter who uses all the tools around it to successfully devour prey.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Battles for survival play out every day in the animal kingdom. For the majority of animals, each battle is an uncertainty. But for a fortunate few, the odds are tilted much more in their favor.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: They take their time because they know time is on their side. When the strike happens, it happens in a violent flurry. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we will meet three of the world’s best lurkers.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: They are purr-fect predators. They move with slow purpose. But attack in violent bursts. They are cats, big cats to be precise. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we will meet three of the most magnificent.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Some animals simply take your breath away. Majestic in so many ways, they move with grace and attack with style. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we meet three majestic animals.

programme.title: To The Ends Of The Earth
programme.desc: The rise of extreme energy, the end of economic growth, the people caught in the middle. To the Ends of the Earth is a feature documentary about the state of our energy system today, and the people we meet are uniquely positioned to watch this global crossroads unfold. For example, the mayor of an Inuit village in Canada's high Arctic who is concerned that seismic testing for oil in the ocean is blowing up the eardrums of the animals that the Inuit hunt to survive. Or the environmental lawyer who goes on a journey to areas that produce energy for the Tarsands of Alberta – he learns of the inputs of energy that have to be put into this resource - and the reasons why the second largest oil project in the world is economically unsustainable. Or the river conservationist in Utah who fights to protect the Colorado River from oil shale projects that would disturb its headwaters.

programme.title: Mummies: Secrets of the Pharaohs
programme.desc: Journey to the royal tombs of Egypt and explore the history of ancient Egyptian society as told through the mummies of the past. The film follows explorers and scientists as they piece together the archeological and genetic clues of Egyptian mummies, and provides audiences with a window into the fascinating and mysterious world of the pharaohs. To unwrap the secrets of the pharaohs is to perhaps glimpse the future of our own civilization.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Express
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain Express propels audiences on a steam train journey through the breathtaking vistas of the Canadian Rockies and relates the epic adventure of building the nation's first transcontinental railway.

programme.title: Wonders of the Arctic
programme.desc: Our ongoing quest to explore and come to terms with the Arctic is presented in the context of the crucial role that ice plays in the north. Ice is to the Arctic as trees are to the rainforest.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: The unknown face of Spain. Snow, rain, clouds, and cold envelop the land. The ibex migrate to the valleys, and wolves patrol the mountains as vultures circle the skies overhead. Though the landscape looks bleak and barren at a glance, there is life thriving here.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: The sun heats the Earth, and life begins again. As they prepare to breed, animals wake from hibernation and build nests in treetops and caves. Whether reptiles, birds, or mammals, all the spring babies fight for survival through their first, most challenging days.

programme.title: Jusqu'a ce que la mort nous sépare
programme.desc: Michael et Madison Roland avaient prévu de passer le reste de leur vie ensemble, jusqu'au jour où les manières autoritaires de Michael ont transformé leur mariage parfait. Avec l'aide de sa meilleure amie, Madison décide de s'enfuir.

programme.title: Plus jamais cela
programme.desc: Une auteure (Mena Suvari) qui dans son œuvre encourage les femmes à ne pas subir des relations violentes découvre qu’elle est suivie par un fou.

programme.title: La Disparue
programme.desc: Le corps de Yoon Seol Hee disparaît à l'Institut National d'Investigation Scientifique. Le détective Woo Joong Shik cherche des indices sur sa disparition, tandis que son mari Park Jin Han affirme qu'elle est en vie.

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Une femme belle, dérangée et dangereuse devient obsédée par un homme marié récemment installé dans le quartier et sème le chaos dans tous les aspects de la vie du couple.

programme.title: Le carrefour du parc
programme.desc: "Il est midi dans un parc isolé au pied des collines de Los Angeles. April est venue pour se suicider ; Krysta et Dennis s’échangent des tendresses dans sa voiture tandis que son collègue Ian attend dans une camionnette de lavage pour chiens ; Peg, l’épouse de Dennis, et sa meilleure amie Claire les ont suivis et prévoient une guérilla amoureuse ; et quatre jeunes trentenaires du même bureau discutent dans une autre camionnette. April demande de l’aide à Ian (du lubrifiant, un tuyau, un briquet), qui lui demande s’il peut l’accompagner. Claire et Peg piègent les amants dans la voiture de Dennis puis ont une conversation intime. Nathan et Babar avouent à Meredith et Cheryl qu’ils sont nudistes, tandis que Meredith insiste pour dire que les deux hommes sont gays. Les vêtements tombent et les vérités éclatent. Est-ce juste une journée de plus à Los Angeles ?"

programme.title: Ma Fille Kidnappée!
programme.desc: Après que Teri, une voisine, ait proposé de "garder" sa fille et que celle-ci ait disparu, Susan, une mère, devra revenir sur la mort de son mari pour la sauver.

programme.title: Un Anglais à New York
programme.desc: Sidney Young est un intellectuel désabusé qui adore autant qu’il méprise le monde des célébrités, de la gloire et du glamour. Son magazine alternatif, Post Modern Review , se moque des stars obsédées par les médias et va à contre-courant des tendances. Lorsqu’on lui propose un poste dans le très conservateur magazine new-yorkais Sharps , c’est un véritable choc ! Il semble que Clayton Harding, le rédacteur en chef de Sharps , ait été amusé par la perturbation d’une soirée post-BAFTA par Young, accompagné d’un cochon déguisé en Babe. Commence alors la descente de Sidney vers le succès : il passe progressivement du statut d’outsider moqué à celui de confident de la starlette Sophie Maes. Au début, il est aidé chez Sharps par sa collègue Alison Olsen, qui cache elle aussi un secret. Leur amitié y survivra-t-elle ?

programme.title: La Nouvelle Locataire
programme.desc: Lorsque son mari est hospitalisé à la suite d'un accident de voiture, Karen, ambulancière, décide de louer leur chambre d'amis en ligne. Tout se passe bien jusqu'à ce que Miranda emménage. Miranda s'infiltre rapidement dans tous les domaines de la vie de Karen. Lorsqu'un des locataires de Karen est retrouvé assassiné, Karen est convaincue que Miranda est impliquée, mais ne se doute pas qu'en mettant son invité psychotique à la porte, Miranda va entrer dans une rage meurtrière.

programme.title: Basket
programme.desc: Une communauté pittoresque du nord-ouest du Pacifique élevant son blé et ses enfants au milieu d'une nation ébranlée par la Première Guerre mondiale est à l'origine de The Basket. À une époque de douleur et de préjugés tissés sur fond de beauté, The Basket évoque finalement le triomphe et l'espoir dans une Amérique en pleine mutation.

programme.title: Présomption d'innocence
programme.desc: Une femme est reconnue coupable d'avoir tué son petit ami et sa meilleure amie dans le feu de la passion bien qu'elle ait été défendue par un avocat de renom. Elle s'enfuit après le procès afin de découvrir qui l'a piégée.

programme.title: Coldwater
programme.desc: À Paris au XVIIe siècle, un élégant bretteur nommé D'Artagnan se retrouve opposé aux puissantes forces qui prennent le contrôle de la France. Il part venger le meurtre de ses parents et découvre un pays déchiré par le chaos et les troubles civils. Son cœur ne s’adoucit que pour Francesca, une fougueuse paysanne qui conquiert D'Artagnan au premier regard.

programme.title: Après Lucia
programme.desc: Lucia est morte dans un accident de voiture il y a six mois ; depuis, son mari Roberto et sa fille Alejandra, tentent de surmonter ce deuil. Afin de prendre un nouveau départ, Roberto décide de s’installer à Mexico. Alejandra se retrouve, nouvelle, dans une classe. Plus jolie, plus brillante, elle est rapidement la cible d’envie et de jalousie de la part de ses camarades. Refusant d’en parler à son père, elle devient une proie, un bouc émissaire.

programme.title: Le refuge
programme.desc: Darlene et sa fille Victoria se réfugient dans un refuge rural isolé pour femmes victimes d'abus, dirigé par Bea, une femme stricte et sévère, mais sympathique et encourageante. Les choses tournent au vinaigre lorsque Bea se révèle être une véritable folle qui exerce une influence particulièrement dangereuse sur l'impressionnable Victoria.

programme.title: Mes Deux amours
programme.desc: Hadrien se lance à la recherche de la femme qu'il aime, Barbara, qui a disparu sans lui donner de nouvelles. Personne ne veut entendre ses angoisses sauf un autre homme, qui affirme à Hadrien que la femme de sa vie est la sienne... La rencontre entre les deux amants de Barbara a lieu à l'endroit où elle a été aperçue pour la dernière fois : la bergerie dont elle a hérité de sa mère. Hadrien Darcourt est arrivé en 4x4, Emmanuel Devailly, en stop. Hadrien est encore en costume, Emmanuel est déjà en tenue de campagne. Hadrien a fait appel à la gendarmerie, Emmanuel à son instinct. Bref, tout les oppose, mais ils aiment tous deux Barbara Cantarella, 45 ans, grand reporter

programme.title: Dans Les Griffes De La Mode
programme.desc: Une jeune femme travaillant depuis peu pour un magasine très à la mode doit apprendre les rudiments de ce rude métier...

programme.title: La Isla Interior
